seoTitle: Free Signature Generator - Draw or Type, PNG
metaDescription: Draw or type your signature and download it as a transparent PNG. Choose colour, pen width and font. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
intro: Draw your signature with a mouse, finger or stylus, or type your name in a handwriting style, then download it as a transparent PNG.
why:
Forms, contracts, invoices and PDFs often need a signature image, and scanning a signed sheet of paper, cropping it and removing the white background is a chore. Many signature websites require an account or place their own branding on the result.

This tool gives you a canvas with a checkered background to show the transparency. Draw directly, choosing the pen width and colour, or switch to Type mode and pick one of four script-style fonts that your device provides. When you press download, it crops the image tightly around your signature, adds a small margin and saves a PNG with a transparent background, ready to place in a document. The image is made in your browser and nothing is uploaded. Whether an image signature is legally valid depends on local law and the document.
howTo: Choose Draw or Type as the mode.
Draw on the canvas, or type your name and pick a font style.
Choose the colour and pen width, and use Clear to start again.

faq.q: Is this a legally binding e-signature?
faq.a: It only makes an image. Whether an image of a signature is accepted depends on the law where you are and the type of document. For contracts that matter, use a recognised e-signature service or ask a lawyer.

faq.q: Can I use it on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. Drawing works with a finger or stylus, and the canvas does not scroll while you draw. Rotate the phone to landscape for more room.

faq.q: Why does the typed signature look different on another device?
faq.a: Type mode uses script fonts installed on your device, and different systems have different ones. The listed fallbacks mean the appearance can change. The downloaded PNG is fixed once saved.
Yes. The checkered pattern is only a guide. The PNG contains only your strokes with a transparent background, so it can sit over any colour in a document or design tool.
